en: A color aerial view over a small, dense town with light‑colored masonry buildings and dark roofs surrounded by abundant green trees. In the background there is a large lake or wide river with forested hills along the far shore under a blue sky with scattered clouds. The architecture looks Northern European, with low‑rise blocks and some wooden houses; there is no prominent single monument, just a harmonious townscape by the water.
